manual_reference.title: RTDS Hardware Manual

confidence_definition.documented: Specific fact explicitly documented for the cited variant; not a mechanical or electrical certification.
confidence_definition.observed: Visible in the cited photograph; dimensional accuracy and unseen geometry are not implied.
confidence_definition.partial: Only the listed subfacts are supported; listed gaps remain open.
confidence_definition.conflicting: Cited sources disagree; no silent reconciliation.

policies: Logical channels, physical connector count and contact count are distinct.
Geometry, connector standard, protocol, pin meaning and compatibility are independent fields.
All physical connection validation remains disabled until a separate approved specification supplies the required conditions.
Public source availability does not grant redistribution rights; manufacturer media stays outside this catalog.
Source dates describe the cited document, not the actual age or revision of the user hardware.
Model releases must add their own saved-file/render/export QA and cannot treat catalog presence as acceptance.
